# fondof

Public URL: https://fondof.netlify.app

## WebMCP tools

- search_skills(query) — search the public skill pool.
- get_skill(skill_hash) — fetch a public skill by its hash.
- compose_skill({ need | url | urls, repo?, top_shards?, private? }) — create a new skill from a need or up to 4 source URLs. Returns markdown, skill_hash, skill_url, source_title and source_urls. On quota error returns error, code="quota_exceeded", hint, unlock, login_url, and remaining.

## Agent notes

- Pass multiple source URLs in the `urls` array, not as repeated calls.
- Cite `source_urls` when presenting composed skills.
- Only set `private: false` when the user explicitly asks to share and is signed in; this also unlocks unlimited forges for the month.
- If compose_skill returns `error` with `code: "quota_exceeded"`, stop and show the user `hint`, `unlock`, and `login_url`.
